transfer_provisions.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this Order, the following functions vested in the President by the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954, as amended (hereinafter referred to as the Act), are delegated to the Secretary of Agriculture: Titles I and IV
transfer_provisions.note: The order re-delegates the Act's functions to the Secretary of Agriculture, the Director of the International Development Cooperation Agency, the Secretary of State, the OMB Director and others, and fixes who uses the foreign currencies under sec. 104. It carries forward the delegations of the revoked orders in new form.

effective_date_reading: Secs. 1-501 and 1-502 say 'is revoked' / 'are revoked'. No effective-date wording appears (secs. 1-101 to 1-502 read in full), so the revocations took effect on signing, June 27, 1980 (printed 45 FR 44245-44247, July 1, 1980).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:10746: sec. 1-502(d) ('Executive Order No. 10746 of December 12, 1957'), under the lead-in 'The following Executive Orders which have previously been superseded, at least in part, are revoked'

conclusion: EO 12220 (signed 1980-06-27, 45 FR 44245, PDF pages 11-13, read once in full) re-delegates the functions under the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954 and revokes EO 10900 (sec. 1-501) and, in sec. 1-502, eight earlier orders 'which have previously been superseded, at least in part', including EO 10746. It has no savings, pending-matter or exception clause and no effective-date wording. The wording of sec. 1-502 says on its face that EO 10746 had already been superseded in whole or part before 1980; the order that did so is EO 10900 (sec. 7(a)(4), 1961-01-05), so EO 12220 is not the first end of EO 10746.
